messages.subject: qtl2convert version 0.32
messages.body_plain:
A new version of R/qtl2convert (version 0.32) has been released on CRAN.
 Windows and Mac binaries will be available within a few days.

There was a problem in encode_geno() that prevented installation on intel Macs.

Karl Broman

(sorry about the message with subject "qtl2charts". there is no such package yet. 😉)

messages.subject: R/qtl2 version 0.40
messages.body_plain:
A new version of R/qtl2 (version 0.40) has been released on CRAN. Windows and Mac binaries will be available within a few days.

There are a few minor changes plus a new function plot_ci() for plotting a set of confidence intervals, such as for the QTL effects at a fixed QTL position.

Karl Broman
